provenance: Frozen re-wrap of two lines of WO-276's criterion 78 as the order was filed: the second line opens with the placeholder <option>, a raw HTML block to the parser, which ends the criteria list there, and this release's criteria reader refuses such a list wherever an open order holds it (WO-276-D175). The branch that carries the reader amends the order, so the re-wrap bridges a clone of the revision before it to this release's index check; the words are the filed ones, moved, as the derived-orders case's re-wrapped input holds them.
